providers.page.autoRoutingHint: When on, a conversation set to Auto-routing picks its model per message. Conversations with a fixed model or a colleague default are never re-routed.
providers.aux.title: Background model calls
providers.aux.hint: Where EYAS's background work goes right now. Only a model that can run an isolated call (no tools, one turn, none of the host's memory) is used: an API provider, or a CLI that can isolate.
providers.aux.group.memory: Memory: capture, consolidation, reflection, import enrichment
providers.aux.group.learning: Learning: heartbeat, self-learning, Forge, skill authoring
providers.aux.group.title: Conversation titles
providers.aux.group.safety: Safety: security judge, completeness critic, goal rubric
providers.aux.reason.noEligibleProvider: No provider can run an isolated call
providers.aux.degradedBanner: Some background work has no model it may use, so it runs its built-in fallback and makes no model call. Enable an API provider, or a CLI whose isolation EYAS has verified.

providers.panel.cliAuthDescPre: No API key needed. Claude Code shares only its sign-in with this server: sign in with the
providers.panel.cliAuthDescPost: CLI as the user EYAS runs as.
providers.panel.runtime.label: Runtime
providers.panel.runtime.unavailable: No usable runtime found — install the CLI or set the override
providers.panel.runtime.overrideInvalid: The override variable is set but does not name an executable file, so EYAS runs no binary for this provider (it never falls back to PATH). Fix or unset it.
providers.panel.runtime.hostShadowed: A CLI on PATH ({{version}}) is not used.
providers.panel.claudeIsolationHint: EYAS runs Claude Code isolated: no host CLAUDE.md, settings, hooks, skills, MCP servers or auto-memory are loaded, and no transcript is kept under ~/.claude/projects. Only the sign-in is shared with the host. To bring host CLAUDE.md content into EYAS, use Settings → System → Data portability → Import data.
providers.panel.isolation.title: Isolation
providers.panel.isolation.verifyHint: Runs the same checks as loading the provider, without a model call: the isolation check and, when signed in, a session start without a prompt.
providers.panel.isolation.verifyUnavaila: Verify now needs the provider to be enabled and its CLI to be found.
providers.panel.isolation.loadFailed: The runtime and isolation status could not be loaded.
providers.panel.isolation.how.claudeCode: EYAS checks Claude Code at the start of every turn, from what it reports when it starts; a turn that fails is stopped. There is no check without a turn, so the status shows the last turn.
providers.panel.isolation.how.grok: Grok runs in EYAS's own home with EYAS's settings (every native tool asks EYAS; memory, imports and telemetry are off). EYAS checks this before every turn with grok inspect, without a model call; a turn that fails is stopped.
providers.panel.isolation.how.kimi: Kimi runs in EYAS's own home with EYAS's settings (auto-approve, telemetry and host skills are off). EYAS checks that home before every turn and counts Kimi as verified only after a session has started on this server with every check passed.
providers.panel.isolation.proof.match: EYAS's isolation release check passed on this version ({{version}}, {{date}}).
providers.panel.isolation.proof.drift: EYAS's isolation release check last passed on version {{version}} ({{date}}), not on the installed one. Every turn is still checked.
providers.panel.isolation.proof.never: Not yet verified on a host: EYAS's isolation release check has never run with this CLI, so its isolation rests on the CLI's source code only. Every turn is still checked.
providers.panel.isolation.proof.unknownV: The CLI reported no version, so it cannot be matched with the version EYAS's isolation release check passed on ({{version}}). Every turn is still checked.
providers.panel.isolation.residual.claud: Remaining risk: Claude Code shares this server's sign-in, and the release check ran with an API key and no real model call. What only a claude.ai account sign-in brings (account-synced skills, account memory, remotely managed settings) is not covered by it.
providers.panel.isolation.residual.grok: Remaining risk: the release check signed Grok in with an API key. Whether a grok.com sign-in makes Grok sync sessions to xAI was not observed.
providers.panel.isolation.residual.kimi: Remaining risk: Kimi's own search and web tools do not ask EYAS first. EYAS stops the turn when one runs, but by then it has run and its result may already reach Kimi's model.
providers.panel.isolation.check.permissi: tool approval not locked to EYAS
providers.panel.isolation.check.rules: instructions or skills from outside the conversation
providers.panel.isolation.check.ungovern: a tool that ran without EYAS's approval
providers.panel.isolation.check.cwd: the working folder was not the one EYAS chose
providers.panel.isolation.check.initMiss: the CLI did not report its start-up configuration
providers.panel.fileSandbox.label: Kernel file sandbox
providers.panel.fileSandbox.active: Active: the CLI's own tools run inside the operating system's file sandbox, which blocks memory outside EYAS and EYAS's private data.
providers.panel.fileSandbox.unavailable: Unavailable on this server: the CLI's own tools run without it. EYAS still checks every tool call it sees.
providers.panel.fileSandbox.unsupported: Not supported: this CLI has no kernel file sandbox. EYAS still checks every tool call it sees.
providers.panel.fileSandbox.reasonNoSoca: socat is not installed; Claude Code needs it next to bubblewrap
providers.panel.fileSandbox.reasonBwrapU: bubblewrap cannot create a sandbox here, usually because user namespaces are disabled
providers.panel.fileSandbox.reasonPlatfo: this operating system has no supported sandbox
providers.panel.fileSandbox.required: Your settings require the sandbox (security.cliSandbox: required): turns with tools are refused while it is unavailable, and no command may run outside it.
providers.panel.fileSandbox.autoHint: A command that asks to run outside the sandbox always waits for your approval.
providers.panel.lmstudioReasoningHint: Reasoning for this model is set in LM Studio itself (default there: {{default}}). EYAS shows it and does not change it.
providers.panel.kimiModelUnpinned: EYAS has not read Kimi's model list yet, so it cannot pin a model or switch thinking on or off: Kimi runs the model it is set to itself. Sign Kimi in for EYAS, then click “Refresh models”.
providers.apiKeySection.hint: Stored encrypted in the secrets vault. Provider reloads automatically after saving.
providers.modelsSection.noModels: No models loaded. Click refresh to fetch from the provider API.
providers.modelsSection.missingFromDisco: Not offered by the last refresh
providers.models.reasoning: Reasoning effort levels this model accepts
providers.models.reasoningUnknown: Reasoning: unknown to EYAS (effort stays Auto)
providers.modelsSection.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. The model list was left unchanged.
